title: Preserving Peste des petits ruminants virus with Whatman paper
author: Akakpo, Oluwole Christophert
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare vaccine dilutions
steps.instruction: Serially dilute the PPR vaccine to obtain an undiluted (10^0) sample and a 10^-1 dilution.

steps.title: Spot dilutions onto paper
steps.instruction: Apply each dilution onto separate pieces of Whatman Grade 3MM CHR chromatography paper.

substeps.instruction: Place a drop of each dilution onto a paper piece.

steps.title: Store paper samples at set temperatures
steps.instruction: Incubate the paper pieces at the following temperatures for 31 days: -20 °C, +4 °C, +24 °C, +37 °C, and +45 °C.

substeps.instruction: Store a set of samples at -20 °C.
Store a set of samples at +4 °C.
Store a set of samples at +24 °C.
Store a set of samples at +37 °C.
Store a set of samples at +45 °C.

steps.title: Extract RNA from paper
steps.instruction: After the 31‑day storage period, perform RNA extraction from each paper sample using an appropriate RNA extraction method.

steps.title: Run RT‑PCR for preservation assessment
steps.instruction: Conduct RT‑PCR on the extracted RNA to evaluate the preservation of PPRV nucleic acid.
